text: {"decision": "reject", "reason": "legalities.id is a dense surrogate auto-increment key (sequential 1–427907) whose integer range trivially contains every mtgoFoilId value (303–70586), so the perfect containment is a numeric-range artifact, not a real reference — an MTGO foil catalog ID has no semantic connection to a legality row's row number, and legalities actually relates to cards via uuid."}
